HOME SCIENCE MARCH — TERMLY EXAM #20
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: HOME SCIENCE MARCH
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Careers in Food and Nutrition? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Careers in Food and Nutrition.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Careers in Food and Nutrition.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Careers in Food and Nutrition.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Careers in Food and Nutrition.

2. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 100 °C
   B. 37 °C
   C. 50 °C
   D. 0 °C

3. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only carbon dioxide
   B. Glucose and oxygen
   C. Nitrogen gas only
   D. Only water vapour

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Care of the Home: Exterior Environment? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Care of the Home: Exterior Environment.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Care of the Home: Exterior Environment.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Care of the Home: Exterior Environment.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Care of the Home: Exterior Environment.

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Consumer Protection 2.3 Special Treatment in Laundry Work 2.4 Ventilation and Li? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Consumer Protection 2.3 Special Treatment in Laundry Work 2.4 Ventilation and Li.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Consumer Protection 2.3 Special Treatment in Laundry Work 2.4 Ventilation and Li.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Consumer Protection 2.3 Special Treatment in Laundry Work 2.4 Ventilation and Li.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Consumer Protection 2.3 Special Treatment in Laundry Work 2.4 Ventilation and Li.

6. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water removes heat too quickly
   B. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   C. Petrol fires have no fuel
   D. Water always increases oxygen

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Special Treatment in Laundry Work? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Special Treatment in Laundry Work.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Special Treatment in Laundry Work.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Special Treatment in Laundry Work.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Special Treatment in Laundry Work.

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Consumer Protection? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Consumer Protection.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Consumer Protection.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Consumer Protection.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Consumer Protection.

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Meals for Special Occasions? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Meals for Special Occasions.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Meals for Special Occasions.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Meals for Special Occasions.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Meals for Special Occasions.

10. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Milk souring
   B. Ice melting to water
   C. Iron rusting
   D. Paper burning to ash

11. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   B. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   C. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   D. A compound can be separated by filtering only

12. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. joule (J)
   B. newton (N)
   C. pascal (Pa)
   D. watt (W)

13. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. A chemical reaction forming ash
   B. Heating until a solid melts
   C. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   D. Movement of water only across a membrane

14. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Convenience Foods? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Convenience Foods.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Convenience Foods.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Convenience Foods.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Convenience Foods.

15. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Burning crop residue every week
   B. Overgrazing continuously
   C. Removing all vegetation
   D. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes

16. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Ventilation and Lighting 2.5 Maternal Health Care 2.6 Child Health Care 2.7 Care? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Ventilation and Lighting 2.5 Maternal Health Care 2.6 Child Health Care 2.7 Care.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Ventilation and Lighting 2.5 Maternal Health Care 2.6 Child Health Care 2.7 Care.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Ventilation and Lighting 2.5 Maternal Health Care 2.6 Child Health Care 2.7 Care.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Ventilation and Lighting 2.5 Maternal Health Care 2.6 Child Health Care 2.7 Care.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Meals for Special Occasions and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Convenience Foods and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Pastry Making and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Yeast Products and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Careers in Food and Nutrition and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Care of the Home: Exterior Environment 2.2 Consumer Protection 2.3 Special Treat and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
